_about: v5 task-kind catalogue (docs/v5/lld.md section 6). Eight kinds (seven in use; new-skill replays in old logs only), approved 28 Oct (C11); every kind but customer and comms needs done_when (D62). The kind decides the checks; the task names its skill. Read by agency (agency-run/scripts/agency.py).

deliverable.skill: named on the task (agency-report-pdf, or an agency's own skill, ...)
deliverable.sent: its pass copies it into artifacts/<customer id>/ (D64)

read.logs: a read event with a number when it counts something

optional: due (only if they gave a date)

comms.note: out is the email text in work/ (subject on the first line); refs are exactly what goes out (R2); to is the customer's address (D67: nothing goes to khalid)

meeting.out: transcript to work/meetings/, recap and action items to artifacts/<customer id>/meetings/ (sent as a comms task)

new-skill.history: replays in old logs only: the tool refuses a new one; nothing is built on the machine (A15)
